design_changes: Fator r is not what puts the films in Anexo III: LC 123 §5-B XV does, with no payroll (§5-M excludes XV). Keep the fator-r pró-labore only as insurance for the stills (design/publicidade risk) and because r is measured on total revenue and undiscriminated bundles go to the worse annex (SC 145/2023).
Set pró-labore at ~30% of trailing-12-month revenue (28% + margin, accountant checks monthly; floor R$1.621); do not pay it in zero-revenue months (SC COSIT 178/2026 applies 20% INSS).

"≈9,1–9,4% on every tier" holds only inside R$12,2–15,8k/month; at R$25k the fator-r route is 14,2% all-in because pró-labore above R$5.000 (revenue above ~R$17.860) pays IRPF. Re-evaluate above ~R$18k/month or after a favourable formal consulta.
CNAE list: 5911-1/02 (primary) + 7410-2/99. Remove 7410-2/03 (it is product/fashion design), and do not add 7420-0/01, 5912-0/99 (not on federal low-risk list), 7319-0/99 or 7311-4/00.
Entity: SLU (sociedade limitada unipessoal) with a denominação (e.g. "O Lançamento Estúdio Ltda") — limited liability and no civil name on the nota fiscal (C2). Not EI, not MEI.
Switch the Simples option ON in the MAT at CNPJ registration — missing it means no Simples until 1 Jan 2028; it cannot be cancelled.

Service code: national 130301 (Emissor Nacional, mandatory for Simples from 1 Nov 2026), NBS 1.1408.12.00 (stills) / 1.2501.21.00 (film); SP municipal 06808 (13.02, 2%). Not 17.06 (5%, SP withholding list).

Describe notas as production (filme publicitário; imagens por composição digital/trucagem), never "planejamento/criação de campanha" — SC 466/2017 keeps Anexo III only if she does not do publicity proper.
Issue one NFS-e per Pix payment (50% order / 50% delivery) into the PJ account only; from 2027 revenue is recognised at invoicing including advances. Clients withhold no IRRF/CSRF.
Stay inside the DAS for IBS/CBS (do not choose the hybrid regime; next window March 2027 only if a Lucro Real client demands credits).
Accountant must keep full books (escrituração contábil) so profits above the presumed-profit cap can be distributed tax-free (LC 123 art. 14 §2).
Budget R$280/month for the accountant (R$195 is promotional), R$236,35/yr TFE, optional R$60/month address protection (home address otherwise public on CNPJ).
Skip MEI: occupation mismatch, ceiling R$6.750/month vs target R$12–16k, >20% overrun = retroactive exclusion with fator r ≈ 0 (Anexo V on stills), exit only in January, and FS12 ≈ 0 in early 2027.
residual_risks: No Solução de Consulta on AI-composited stills: artes visuais (III) vs design/publicidade (fator r) unresolved — neutralised by fator r at ~1,9 pts cost; a free formal consulta could remove the cost.
